war_summary: War 139 is on day 128 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Callahan's Passage has become the hottest front by far: 1h casualty rates have surged to ~940-1070/hr per side (accelerating), ~7-8k casualties/24h each, enlistments accelerating (~84/hr), split now 6-4 Colonial with fresh flips at Lochan Berth and Solas Gorge (latest event minutes before cutoff). Onyx remains extremely intense (~1100-1300/hr per side over 2h) with The Waif as a hotspot (11 events/24h), split 4-2 Colonial. Speaking Woods shows sustained heavy fighting (~870-1000/hr over 2h, ~11k casualties/24h each side) with recent activity at The Filament, Hush and Stem; split 5-3 Warden. Endless Shore continues churning with 43 events/24h around Brackish Point, Saltbrook Channel, The Overland, Wellchurch and Woodbind; rates cooled from the prior surge to ~50-65/hr over 2h but the latest event was seconds before cutoff; it stands 8-1-1 Colonial. Oarbreaker stays very active (41 events/24h, Grisly Refuge alone 12 events, plus Posterus, Gold, Integrum, The Dirk), though casualty rates are cooling to ~20-40/hr over 1h; split 6-2-1 Colonial. Clahstra shows a notable cooldown after its prior escalation (~500-580/hr over 2h, down from ~1050+) but logged 21 events/24h at Transept, Bewailing Fort, East Narthex and Weephome; split 4-4. Marban Hollow shows warden-heavy fighting (~250-320/hr warden vs ~90-110 colonial over 2h) with 10 events/24h at Sanctum and Lockheed, 4-4. Godcrofts is reigniting sharply (~150-180/hr per side over 1h, accelerating) with 14 events/24h around Lipsia, Argosa and Saegio, 8-1 Colonial. Mooring County, StemaLanding, Tempest Island and Tyrant Foothills show moderate ongoing activity. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
